inputs.title: Preview of a forthcoming supernova
inputs.acquisition: The publisher's JPEG (1089 x 1033 px), downloaded unchanged; not tracked. Its scale and direction on the sky are the file's embedded tags; its place is set by the star (recipe observation). A display composite, not a calibrated scientific array.
inputs.license: CC-BY-4.0; retain the complete recorded credit.

inputs.title: Eta Carinae Homunculus Nebula: the model of Steffen et al. (2014) as a printable surface, 17101 triangles
inputs.acquisition: The binary STL as NASA 3D Resources serves it, downloaded unchanged; not tracked. Read by the image-layer bake for where each sight line crosses the surface.
inputs.license: NASA 3D Resources: free and without copyright, under NASA's media usage guidelines.

attributions.label: VLT/X-shooter
attributions.reason: A model made from ESO VLT/X-shooter spectra (programme 088.D-0873), not an observation of its own.

inputs.title: The dust lanes on the lobes, 0 to 1 on the bank's face grid
inputs.license: Public NASA mission data: cite the programmes.
inputs.acquisition: Built by the generator from the picture and HST ACS/HRC F220W and F550M (GO 9973, 2003), each registered on the picture by its lobes' fine detail: dark lines found at four widths (Frangi et al. 1998) and weighted into one map with the settings chosen on the Nebula Lab's filament tuner. Not tracked (the repository ignores pictures under source/): rebuilt by the generator from the downloads, or restored from the source cache once published there.

inputs.title: The lobes' ultraviolet detail where the picture is the star's glare, on the bank's face grid
inputs.license: Public NASA mission data: cite the programmes.
inputs.acquisition: Built by the generator from HST ACS/HRC F220W (GO 9973, 2003) and WFC3/UVIS F280N (GO 15289, 2018), each registered on the picture (F280N from free expansion since 1843): each band's log brightness less its 10-pixel blur, in units of its own scatter over the lobes, F280N's saturated pixels left out; red holds 128 plus 40 times the detail, green how far it counts. Not tracked (the repository ignores pictures under source/): rebuilt by the generator from the downloads, or restored from the source cache once published there.

inputs.title: Regions drawn on the picture: the equatorial skirt where it lies on the sky, over the lobes too
inputs.credit: Drawn by hand on ESA/Hubble & NASA's picture
inputs.acquisition: Drawn by hand on the picture in the Nebula Lab's Regions tool, as closed paths of picture pixels: the skirt's two fans either side of the waist. Tracked.
